title: PLAIN: Leveraging High Internal Bandwidth in PIM for Accelerating Large Language Model Inference via Mixed-Precision Quantization
problem: DRAM-PIM systems have limited computational capabilities supporting only element-wise and GEMV operations, making them insufficient for LLM workloads which are compute-heavy in FC layers.
motivation: DRAM-based PIM offers commercial viability but lacks adequate compute for LLM acceleration without powerful host processors.
method: Software/hardware co-design with layer-wise mixed-precision quantization algorithm, GPU+PIM hybrid execution using HBM for attention and conventional compute for FC layers, and workload-aware dataflow scheduler.
key_novelty: Mixed-precision quantization algorithm accounting for both algorithmic and hardware characteristics for optimal PIM mapping.
contributions: 5.03x performance boost over GPU with same memory parameters
Workload-aware dataflow scheduler for mixed-precision tensors
limitations: Evaluation limited to specific models and memory configurations; scalability to larger models unclear.
